dumps the archive's blocks

Usage: dolos data dump blocks [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --from-slot <SLOT>  the first slot to dump
      --to-slot <SLOT>    the last slot to dump
      --limit <N>         Print at most this many records; 0 prints every one [default: 100]
      --offset <N>        Skip this many records first [default: 0]
      --format <FORMAT>   How to print the result: text for people, JSON for scripts [default: text]
                          [possible values: text, json]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>   
  -h, --help              Print help
